note: Provision summaries are paraphrases for navigation, not legal text.

provisions.title: Grounds for processing
provisions.summary: Process personal data only for a lawful purpose, with the Data Principal's consent or for a certain legitimate use.

provisions.title: Notice
provisions.summary: Every consent request is accompanied or preceded by a notice of the personal data, the purpose, how to exercise rights and how to complain to the Board, available in English or an Eighth Schedule language.

provisions.title: Valid consent
provisions.summary: Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous, given by clear affirmative action, and limited to data necessary for the specified purpose.

provisions.title: Withdrawal of consent
provisions.summary: The Data Principal may withdraw consent at any time, with ease comparable to giving it.

provisions.title: Consent managers
provisions.summary: Consent may be given, managed, reviewed or withdrawn through a registered Consent Manager.

provisions.title: Certain legitimate uses
provisions.summary: Limited grounds (clauses (a)–(i)) on which personal data may be processed without consent.

provisions.title: Accountability
provisions.summary: The Data Fiduciary is responsible for compliance, including processing by its Data Processors.

provisions.title: Data Processors under contract
provisions.summary: A Data Processor may be engaged only under a valid contract.

provisions.title: Accuracy
provisions.summary: Ensure completeness, accuracy and consistency where data is used for decisions about, or disclosed to another fiduciary about, the Data Principal.

provisions.title: Technical and organisational measures
provisions.summary: Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for effective observance of the Act.

provisions.title: Security safeguards
provisions.summary: Protect personal data in its possession or control, including processing by processors, with reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.

provisions.title: Breach intimation
provisions.summary: Intimate the Board and each affected Data Principal of a personal data breach.

provisions.title: Erasure
provisions.summary: Erase personal data (and have processors erase it) when consent is withdrawn or the specified purpose is no longer served, unless retention is required by law.

provisions.title: Contact person
provisions.summary: Publish the business contact information of the DPO or a person able to answer questions about processing.

provisions.title: Grievance redressal mechanism
provisions.summary: Establish an effective mechanism to redress Data Principals' grievances.

provisions.title: Children: verifiable parental consent
provisions.summary: Obtain verifiable consent of the parent (or lawful guardian) before processing a child's personal data.

provisions.title: Children: no detrimental processing
provisions.summary: Do not process children's data in a way likely to cause any detrimental effect on a child's well-being.

provisions.title: Children: no tracking or targeted advertising
provisions.summary: Do not undertake tracking or behavioural monitoring of children or targeted advertising directed at children.

provisions.title: Significant Data Fiduciaries
provisions.summary: Notified SDFs appoint a DPO based in India and an independent data auditor, and carry out periodic DPIAs and audits.

provisions.title: Right to access information
provisions.summary: Provide a summary of personal data processed, processing activities, and identities of fiduciaries and processors it was shared with.

provisions.title: Right to correction and erasure
provisions.summary: Correct, complete, update and erase personal data on request.

provisions.title: Right of grievance redressal
provisions.summary: Respond to grievances within the prescribed period before the Data Principal approaches the Board.

provisions.title: Right to nominate
provisions.summary: Allow the Data Principal to nominate another person to exercise rights on death or incapacity.

provisions.title: Transfer outside India
provisions.summary: Transfers outside India are permitted except to countries or territories restricted by Central Government notification.

controls.title: Lawful basis recorded per processing activity
controls.objective: Every processing activity has consent or a specific s.7 legitimate use as its basis.
controls.evidenceGuidance: ROPA entries with legal basis and, for legitimate use, the s.7 clause.

controls.title: Notice before or with every consent request
controls.objective: Notice lists the data, purpose, rights and how to complain to the Board, in English or an Eighth Schedule language.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Notice versions and languages; consent records referencing the notice version.

controls.title: Valid, purpose-specific consent
controls.objective: Consent is affirmative, specific and limited to necessary data; no pre-ticked boxes or bundling.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Consent UI review, consent records per purpose.

controls.title: Withdrawal as easy as giving consent
controls.objective: Data Principals can withdraw consent through a mechanism comparable to granting it.

controls.title: Data minimisation
controls.objective: Only personal data necessary for the specified purpose is collected and flows to systems that need it.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Data categories per activity; code data map.

controls.title: Processors and third parties under contract
controls.objective: Every processor or third party receiving personal data has a valid contract (DPA).

controls.title: Accuracy for decisions and disclosures
controls.objective: Data used for decisions or shared with other fiduciaries is complete, accurate and consistent.

controls.title: Reasonable security safeguards
controls.objective: Encryption, access control, logging and backups protect personal data, including at processors.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Security measures per activity; security test results.

controls.title: No personal data in application logs
controls.objective: Personal data and secrets do not leak into logs or other uncontrolled sinks.

controls.title: Breach intimation process
controls.objective: Breaches are reported to the Board and affected Data Principals in the prescribed form and time.

controls.title: Retention limits and erasure
controls.objective: Each activity has a retention period and erasure method; data is erased when the purpose is served or consent is withdrawn.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Retention rules in ROPA; erasure records.

controls.title: Published DPO / contact details
controls.objective: Business contact of the DPO or responsible person is published on the website and in responses.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Website privacy page; organization DPO settings.

controls.title: Grievance redressal
controls.objective: A working grievance channel with response within the prescribed period.

controls.title: Verifiable parental consent for children
controls.objective: Children's data is processed only with verifiable consent of a parent or lawful guardian.

controls.title: No tracking or targeted ads for children
controls.objective: No behavioural monitoring, tracking or targeted advertising directed at children; no detrimental processing.

controls.title: Data Principal rights fulfilment
controls.objective: Access, correction, erasure and nomination requests can be made and are fulfilled.

controls.title: Cross-border transfers
controls.objective: Transfers outside India are known and none go to restricted countries.

controls.title: Significant Data Fiduciary obligations
controls.objective: DPO in India, independent data auditor, annual DPIA and audit.
controls.evidenceGuidance: DPIA reports, audit reports, DPO appointment.
